def absolute_time(value):
 assert isinstance(value,str) and re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d(?:\.\d{1,6})?Z',value),'BINDING_DEADLINE'
 return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z','+00:00')).timestamp()
def binding_shape(b,clock=time.time):
 assert isinstance(b,dict) or isinstance(b,MappingProxyType),'EXECUTION_BINDING'
 if b.get('status')!='ISSUED':raise RuntimeError('execution_binding_unissued')
 for key in ['source','sourceReady','outputParent','normalAdmissionReceipt']:
  value=b.get(key);assert isinstance(value,str) and value.startswith('/home/ubuntu/SeaBridgeAI/everything-claude-code/.ecc/goal/') and str(Path(value))==value and '..' not in Path(value).parts,'BINDING_PATH'
 for key in ['sourceSHA256','sourceReadySHA256','normalAdmissionSHA256']:
  assert isinstance(b.get(key),str) and re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{64}',b[key]),'BINDING_PIN'
 assert type(b.get('sourceBytes')) is int and 0<b['sourceBytes']<=65536,'BINDING_SOURCE_SIZE'
 assert isinstance(b.get('actor'),str) and re.fullmatch('rea-greenly-lca-[a-z0-9-]{1,80}',b['actor']),'BINDING_ACTOR'
 assert isinstance(b.get('sourceActor'),str) and b['sourceActor']!=b['actor'] and re.fullmatch('[a-z0-9-]{1,120}',b['sourceActor']),'BINDING_SOURCE_ACTOR'
 assert isinstance(b.get('nonce'),str) and re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{32,64}',b['nonce']) and type(b.get('attempt')) is int and b['attempt']==1,'BINDING_NONCE_ATTEMPT'
 deadline=absolute_time(b.get('absoluteStop'));assert deadline<=absolute_time(LEASE['captureUseCeilingUTC']) and deadline-clock()>22,'ABSOLUTE_CUTOFF_RESERVE'
 return deadline
def duration_micros(value):
 assert isinstance(value,str) and 0<len(value)<=80,'NATIVE_TIME_SHAPE'
 if re.fullmatch(r'\d+',value):
  result=int(value);assert result<=9007199254740991,'NATIVE_TIME_SHAPE';return result
 units={'d':86400000000,'h':3600000000,'min':60000000,'s':1000000,'ms':1000,'us':1,'µs':1};total=0;end=0;previous=86400000001;count=0
 for m in re.finditer(r'(\d+)(?:\.(\d{1,6}))?(us|µs|ms|min|s|h|d)',value):
  unit=units[m[3]];assert not value[end:m.start()].strip() and unit<previous,'NATIVE_TIME_SHAPE'
  fraction=m[2] or '';number=int(m[1]+fraction)*unit;scale=10**len(fraction);assert number%scale==0,'NATIVE_TIME_PRECISION'
  total+=number//scale;previous=unit;end=m.end();count+=1
 assert count and not value[end:].strip() and total<=9007199254740991,'NATIVE_TIME_SHAPE'
 return total

 active=int(p['ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic']);execution=int(p['ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic']);runtime=duration_micros(p.get('RuntimeMaxUSec',''));extra=duration_micros(p.get('RuntimeRandomizedExtraUSec',''));stop=duration_micros(p.get('TimeoutStopUSec',''))
 assert active==int(LEASE['activeEnterMicros']) and execution==int(LEASE['execStartMicros']) and runtime==int(LEASE['runtimeMicros']) and extra==0 and stop==int(LEASE['stopGraceMicros']),'NATIVE_LEASE_BINDING'
 expiry=active+runtime;assert expiry==int(LEASE['nativeExpiresMonotonicMicros']) and expiry-mono>60000000 and absolute_time(LEASE['captureUseCeilingUTC'])-wall>60,'NATIVE_LEASE_MARGIN'
 return {'activeEnterMicros':str(active),'execStartMicros':str(execution),'runtimeMicros':str(runtime),'nativeExpiresMonotonicMicros':str(expiry),'remainingMicros':str(expiry-mono),'wallCeilingUTC':LEASE['captureUseCeilingUTC']}
def validate_admission_record(record,b,clock=time.time):
 assert isinstance(record,dict) and record.get('schema')=='rea.exact-passive-normal-admission.v1','NORMAL_ADMISSION_RECORD'
 for key in ['normalRegister','normalControlledOriginalGoalAdmit','exactCheckWrite','sourceActorClosedFreshReadback']:
  assert isinstance(record.get(key),dict),'HISTORICAL_BOOLEAN_NOT_ADMISSION'
 reg=record['normalRegister'];admit=record['normalControlledOriginalGoalAdmit'];write=record['exactCheckWrite'];closed=record['sourceActorClosedFreshReadback']
 assert reg.get('id')==b['actor'] and reg.get('state')=='active','NORMAL_SESSION'
 assert admit.get('admitted') is True and admit.get('runtime')=='codex' and admit.get('mode')=='controlled' and admit.get('session')==b['actor'],'NORMAL_GOAL_ADMISSION'
 assert write.get('allowed') is True and write.get('session')==b['actor'] and isinstance(write.get('paths'),list) and any(isinstance(p,str) and '..' not in Path(p).parts and str(Path('/home/ubuntu/SeaBridgeAI/everything-claude-code')/p)==b['outputParent'] for p in write['paths']),'NORMAL_OUTPUT_ADMISSION'
 assert closed.get('id')==b['sourceActor'] and closed.get('state')=='closed','SOURCE_WRITER_NOT_CLOSED'
 assert record.get('session')==b['actor'] and record.get('sourceSHA256')==b['sourceSHA256'] and record.get('sourceREADYsha256')==b['sourceReadySHA256'] and record.get('nonce')==b['nonce'] and record.get('cutoff')==b['absoluteStop'],'ADMISSION_BINDING_MISMATCH'
 age=clock()-absolute_time(record.get('at'));assert 0<=age<=120,'ADMISSION_STALE'
 return record
def validate_observer_binding(code,b):

 assert all(x.get(k)==v for k,v in expected.items()),'OBSERVER_NONCE_BINDING'

def digest(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def boundread(path,cap):
 f=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK)
 try:
  a=os.fstat(f);assert stat.S_ISREG(a.st_mode);b=bytearray()
  while len(b)<=cap:
   x=os.read(f,min(65536,cap+1-len(b)))
   if not x:break
   b.extend(x)
  z=os.fstat(f);assert len(b)<=cap and (a.st_dev,a.st_ino,a.st_size,a.st_mtime_ns,a.st_ctime_ns)==(z.st_dev,z.st_ino,z.st_size,z.st_mtime_ns,z.st_ctime_ns)
  return bytes(b)
 finally:os.close(f)
def fsyncdir():
 d=os.open(P,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
 try:os.fsync(d)
 finally:os.close(d)
def save(name,v):
 b=(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n').encode();assert len(b)<=65536;f=os.open(P/name,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
 try:
  offset=0
  while offset<len(b):offset+=os.write(f,b[offset:offset+65536])
  os.fsync(f)
 finally:os.close(f)
 fsyncdir();return {'path':str(P/name),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':digest(b)}
def proc(pid):
 b=boundread('/proc/'+str(pid)+'/stat',8192).decode();a=b[b.rfind(')')+2:].split();u=boundread('/proc/'+str(pid)+'/status',16384).decode();line=next(x for x in u.splitlines() if x.startswith('Uid:'));return {'pid':pid,'ppid':int(a[1]),'pgid':int(a[2]),'session':int(a[3]),'startTicks':a[19],'uid':int(line.split()[1])}
def properties(unit,names):
 x=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/systemctl','show',unit,'--property='+','.join(names)],capture_output=True,timeout=2,env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LC_ALL':'C'});assert x.returncode==0 and len(x.stdout)<=8192,'NATIVE_OBSERVATION';return dict(y.split('=',1) for y in x.stdout.decode().strip().splitlines() if '=' in y)
def members(pgid,deadline=None):
 result=[];count=0
 for entry in os.scandir('/proc'):
  if deadline is not None and time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise RuntimeError('RECONCILIATION_DEADLINE')
  if not entry.name.isdigit():continue
  count+=1
  if count>65536:raise RuntimeError('PROC_SCAN_BOUND')
  try:
   b=boundread('/proc/'+entry.name+'/stat',8192).decode();a=b[b.rfind(')')+2:].split()
   if int(a[2])==pgid:result.append(proc(int(entry.name)))
  except FileNotFoundError:continue
  except ProcessLookupError:continue
 return result

def budget(deadline,maximum=0.5):
 left=deadline-time.monotonic();assert left>0,'NATIVE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED';return min(maximum,left)
def require_native_containment():
 unit=BINDING.get('nativeUnit');nonce=BINDING.get('nonce')
 assert isinstance(nonce,str) and re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{32}',nonce),'NATIVE_NONCE'

NATIVE_ASSERTION_CODES={'NATIVE_OBSERVATION','NATIVE_PROPERTIES','NATIVE_PROCESS_IDENTITY','NATIVE_PROCESS_CGROUP','NATIVE_PROCESS_DRIFT','NATIVE_CHILD_LIMITS','NATIVE_CHILD_TIMING','NATIVE_EPOCH','NATIVE_CGROUP','NATIVE_COMMAND_IDENTITY'}
NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_STEPS={'PROPERTY_READ','PROPERTY_PARSE','PROCESS_READ','PROCESS_IDENTITY','PROCESS_CGROUP','COMMAND_SNAPSHOT','CHILD_LIMITS','CHILD_TIMING','UNIT_IDENTITY','INVOCATION_IDENTITY','START_EPOCH','COMMAND_IDENTITY','UNKNOWN'}
NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_FLAGS={'propertyStatusZero','stdoutBounded','stderrBounded','lineHasEquals','knownUniqueProperty','requiredPropertiesPresent','pidWellFormed','uidUbuntu','ppidInit','noNewPrivileges','cgroupMatched','commandMatchesNode','commandStartsEnv','unitMatched','descriptionMatched','active','activating','invocationWellFormed','startWellFormed','startAfterIntent','memoryMaxMatched','swapMaxMatched','tasksMaxMatched','killModeMatched','noNewPrivilegesMatched','protectProcMatched','procSubsetMatched','writePathMatched','delegateMatched'}
NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_PHASES={'NORMAL_ADMISSION','NATIVE_LAUNCH','NATIVE_BIND','NONCAPTURE_GATE','STREAM_READ'}
NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTEXT={'step':'UNKNOWN','checks':{}}
def note_native_check(step,checks=None):
 global NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTEXT
 state={k:None if step=='PROPERTY_READ' and checks is None else NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTEXT['checks'].get(k) for k in ('active','activating')}
 NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTEXT={'step':step if step in NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_STEPS else 'UNKNOWN','checks':{**state,**{k:v for k,v in (checks or {}).items() if k in NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_FLAGS and (type(v) is bool or v is None)}}}
def fixed_native_failure(error,phase):
 legacy={'NATIVE_COMMAND_AUTHORITY_REFUSED','FOREIGN_REPLACEMENT_NO_STOP','NORMAL_ADMISSION_REFUSED','NATIVE_LAUNCH_REFUSED','NATIVE_EPOCH_UNKNOWN','STREAM_BOUND','STREAM_OR_TRANSPORT_UNKNOWN','NATIVE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED'}
 code=error.args[0] if len(error.args)==1 and type(error.args[0]) is str else None
 actualAssertion=isinstance(error,AssertionError) and code in NATIVE_ASSERTION_CODES
 reason=code if code in legacy or actualAssertion else {'NORMAL_ADMISSION':'NORMAL_ADMISSION_UNKNOWN','NATIVE_LAUNCH':'NATIVE_LAUNCH_UNKNOWN','NATIVE_BIND':'NATIVE_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN','NONCAPTURE_GATE':'NONCAPTURE_GATE_REFUSED','STREAM_READ':'STREAM_UNKNOWN'}.get(phase,'NATIVE_UNKNOWN')
 return {'reason':reason,'stage':phase if phase in NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_PHASES else 'UNKNOWN','lastNativeStep':NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTEXT['step'],'failedPredicate':code if actualAssertion or code=='NATIVE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED' else 'UNKNOWN','checks':dict(NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTEXT['checks'])}

def startup_metadata(p,unit,context):
 # Pending means only an exact owned startup observation, never process admission.
 intent,expected,prior=context['intent'],context['expected'],context['observed']
 budget(context['deadline'])
 assert context['transport'].poll() is None,'NATIVE_LAUNCH_REFUSED'
 active=p.get('ActiveState')=='active';activating=p.get('ActiveState')=='activating'
 note_native_check('UNIT_IDENTITY',{'active':active,'activating':activating,'unitMatched':p.get('Id')==unit==BINDING['nativeUnit'],'descriptionMatched':p.get('Description')==BINDING['nativeDescription'],'cgroupMatched':p.get('ControlGroup')==expected})
 assert unit==BINDING['nativeUnit'],'NATIVE_EPOCH'
 if native_absent(p,expected):
  assert prior is None and p.get('ActiveState')=='inactive' and p.get('SubState')=='dead' and not p.get('InvocationID','') and p.get('ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic','0') in ('','0'),'NATIVE_EPOCH'
  return True
 assert p.get('Id')==unit and p.get('Description')==BINDING['nativeDescription'] and p.get('LoadState')=='loaded' and (active or activating),'NATIVE_EPOCH'
 inv=p.get('InvocationID','');start=p.get('ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic','');pid=p.get('MainPID','');cg=p.get('ControlGroup','')
 assert (inv=='' or re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{32}',inv)) and re.fullmatch('0|[1-9][0-9]*',start) and re.fullmatch('0|[1-9][0-9]*',pid),'NATIVE_EPOCH'
 assert cg==expected or cg=='' and cgroup_absent(expected),'NATIVE_EPOCH'
 if start!='0':assert intent<=int(start)<=time.clock_gettime_ns(time.CLOCK_MONOTONIC)//1000 and inv!='','NATIVE_EPOCH'
 if pid!='0':assert start!='0' and inv!='' and cg==expected,'NATIVE_EPOCH'
 if active:assert inv!='' and start!='0' and pid!='0' and cg==expected,'NATIVE_EPOCH'
 if prior is not None:
  assert (not prior['invocation'] or inv==prior['invocation']) and (prior['started']=='0' or start==prior['started']) and (prior['pid']=='0' or pid==prior['pid']) and (not prior['cgroup'] or cg==prior['cgroup']),'NATIVE_EPOCH'
 child_limits(p)
 context['observed']={'invocation':inv,'started':start,'pid':pid,'cgroup':cg}
 return activating

def native_properties(unit,deadline,*,startup=None):
 note_native_check('PROPERTY_READ')
 r=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/systemctl','show',unit,'--property='+','.join(NATIVE_FIELDS)],capture_output=True,timeout=budget(deadline),env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LC_ALL':'C'})
 note_native_check('PROPERTY_READ',{'propertyStatusZero':r.returncode==0,'stdoutBounded':len(r.stdout)<=16384,'stderrBounded':len(r.stderr)<=8192})
 assert r.returncode==0 and len(r.stdout)<=16384 and len(r.stderr)<=8192,'NATIVE_OBSERVATION'
 out={}
 for line in r.stdout.decode().splitlines():
  note_native_check('PROPERTY_PARSE',{'lineHasEquals':'=' in line})
  assert '=' in line,'NATIVE_PROPERTIES';k,v=line.split('=',1);note_native_check('PROPERTY_PARSE',{'knownUniqueProperty':k in NATIVE_FIELDS and k not in out});assert k in NATIVE_FIELDS and k not in out,'NATIVE_PROPERTIES';out[k]=v
 note_native_check('PROPERTY_PARSE',{'requiredPropertiesPresent':all(k in out for k in ['LoadState','MainPID','ControlGroup'])})
 assert all(k in out for k in ['LoadState','MainPID','ControlGroup']),'NATIVE_PROPERTIES'
 note_native_check('UNIT_IDENTITY',{'active':out.get('ActiveState')=='active','activating':out.get('ActiveState')=='activating'})
 if startup is not None and startup_metadata(out,unit,startup):return out
 if out.get('MainPID','0')!='0':
  note_native_check('PROCESS_READ',{'pidWellFormed':bool(re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*',out['MainPID']))})
  assert re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*',out['MainPID']),'NATIVE_PROCESS_IDENTITY'
  pid=int(out['MainPID']);a=proc(pid);status=boundread('/proc/'+str(pid)+'/status',16384).decode()
  note_native_check('PROCESS_IDENTITY',{'uidUbuntu':a['uid']==1000,'noNewPrivileges':bool(re.search(r'^NoNewPrivs:\s+1$',status,re.M))})
  assert a['uid']==1000 and re.search(r'^NoNewPrivs:\s+1$',status,re.M),'NATIVE_PROCESS_IDENTITY'
  note_native_check('PROCESS_CGROUP')
  assert boundread('/proc/'+str(pid)+'/cgroup',8192).decode().strip()=='0::'+out.get('ControlGroup',''),'NATIVE_PROCESS_CGROUP'
  note_native_check('COMMAND_SNAPSHOT')
  commandBytes=boundread('/proc/'+str(pid)+'/cmdline',65536);command=digest(commandBytes);note_native_check('COMMAND_SNAPSHOT',{'commandMatchesNode':commandBytes==b'/usr/local/bin/node\x00--max-old-space-size=64\x00/control/OBSERVER.cjs\x00','commandStartsEnv':commandBytes.startswith(b'/usr/bin/env\x00-i\x00')});assert proc(pid)==a,'NATIVE_PROCESS_DRIFT'
  out['startTicks']=a['startTicks'];out['procUID']=str(a['uid']);out['procCommandSHA256']=command
 return out
def cgroup_absent(cgroup):
 assert isinstance(cgroup,str) and cgroup.startswith('/') and '..' not in cgroup.split('/') and not re.search(r'[\s\x00-\x1f]',cgroup),'NATIVE_CGROUP'
 try:os.lstat('/sys/fs/cgroup'+cgroup);return False
 except FileNotFoundError:return True
def native_absent(p,expected):
 return p.get('LoadState')=='not-found' and p.get('MainPID')=='0' and p.get('ControlGroup')=='' and cgroup_absent(expected)
def native_same(p,b):
 if native_absent(p,b['cgroup']):return True
 return p.get('InvocationID')==b['invocation'] and p.get('Description')==b['description'] and p.get('ControlGroup') in ['',b['cgroup']] and (p.get('MainPID')=='0' or p.get('MainPID')==str(b['pid']) and p.get('ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic')==b['started'] and p.get('startTicks')==b['startTicks'] and p.get('procUID')=='1000' and p.get('procCommandSHA256')==b['commandSHA256'])
def original_epoch_gone(b):
 try:return proc(b['pid'])['startTicks']!=b['startTicks']
 except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError):return True
def native_ceased(p,b):
 return native_same(p,b) and (native_absent(p,b['cgroup']) or p.get('ActiveState') in ['inactive','failed'] and p.get('MainPID')=='0' and cgroup_absent(b['cgroup'])) and original_epoch_gone(b)
def child_limits(p):
 expected={'MemoryMax':'134217728','MemorySwapMax':'0','TasksMax':'32','KillMode':'control-group','NoNewPrivileges':'yes','ProtectProc':'invisible','ProcSubset':'pid','ReadWritePaths':str(P),'Delegate':'no'}
 note_native_check('CHILD_LIMITS',dict(zip(['memoryMaxMatched','swapMaxMatched','tasksMaxMatched','killModeMatched','noNewPrivilegesMatched','protectProcMatched','procSubsetMatched','writePathMatched','delegateMatched'],[p.get(k)==v for k,v in expected.items()])))
 assert all(p.get(k)==v for k,v in expected.items()),'NATIVE_CHILD_LIMITS'
 note_native_check('CHILD_TIMING')
 assert duration_micros(p.get('CPUQuotaPerSecUSec',''))==1000000 and duration_micros(p.get('RuntimeMaxUSec',''))==9000000 and duration_micros(p.get('TimeoutStartUSec',''))==1000000 and duration_micros(p.get('TimeoutStopUSec',''))==1000000,'NATIVE_CHILD_TIMING'
 return True
def bind_native_epoch(p,intent,expected):
 note_native_check('UNIT_IDENTITY',{'unitMatched':p.get('Id')==BINDING['nativeUnit'],'descriptionMatched':p.get('Description')==BINDING['nativeDescription'],'cgroupMatched':p.get('ControlGroup')==expected,'active':p.get('ActiveState')=='active'})
 assert p.get('Id')==BINDING['nativeUnit'] and p.get('Description')==BINDING['nativeDescription'] and p.get('ControlGroup')==expected and p.get('ActiveState')=='active','NATIVE_EPOCH'
 note_native_check('INVOCATION_IDENTITY',{'invocationWellFormed':bool(re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{32}',p.get('InvocationID',''))),'pidWellFormed':bool(re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*',p.get('MainPID','')))})
 assert re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{32}',p.get('InvocationID','')) and re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*',p.get('MainPID','')),'NATIVE_EPOCH'
 start=p.get('ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic','');note_native_check('START_EPOCH',{'startWellFormed':bool(re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*',start)),'startAfterIntent':bool(re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*',start)) and intent<=int(start)});assert re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*',start) and intent<=int(start)<=time.clock_gettime_ns(time.CLOCK_MONOTONIC)//1000,'NATIVE_EPOCH'
 child_limits(p);note_native_check('PROCESS_READ');pid=int(p['MainPID']);before=proc(pid);status=boundread('/proc/'+str(pid)+'/status',16384).decode()
 note_native_check('PROCESS_IDENTITY',{'uidUbuntu':before['uid']==1000,'ppidInit':before['ppid']==1,'noNewPrivileges':bool(re.search(r'^NoNewPrivs:\s+1$',status,re.M))})
 assert before['uid']==1000 and before['ppid']==1 and re.search(r'^NoNewPrivs:\s+1$',status,re.M),'NATIVE_PROCESS_IDENTITY'
 note_native_check('PROCESS_CGROUP')
 assert boundread('/proc/'+str(pid)+'/cgroup',8192).decode().strip()=='0::'+expected,'NATIVE_CGROUP'
 expectedCmd=digest(b'\0'.join(os.fsencode(x) for x in ['/usr/local/bin/node','--max-old-space-size=64','/control/OBSERVER.cjs'])+b'\0')
 note_native_check('COMMAND_IDENTITY')
 commandBytes=boundread('/proc/'+str(pid)+'/cmdline',65536);note_native_check('COMMAND_IDENTITY',{'commandMatchesNode':digest(commandBytes)==expectedCmd,'commandStartsEnv':commandBytes.startswith(b'/usr/bin/env\x00-i\x00')})

 return MappingProxyType({'pid':pid,'startTicks':before['startTicks'],'invocation':p['InvocationID'],'description':p['Description'],'cgroup':expected,'started':start,'commandSHA256':expectedCmd})

def validate_meminfo_mounts(text,dev):
 assert len(text.encode())<=131072,'MEMINFO_MOUNT_BOUND';lines=text.strip().splitlines();assert 0<len(lines)<=512,'MEMINFO_MOUNT_BOUND';alias=None;procmount=None
 for line in lines:
  assert len(line)<=2048 and line.count(' - ')==1,'MEMINFO_MOUNT_SHAPE';a,b=line.split(' - ');a=a.split(' ');b=b.split(' ');assert len(a)>=6 and len(b)>=3,'MEMINFO_MOUNT_SHAPE'
  if a[4]=='/control/HOST_MEMINFO':assert alias is None,'MEMINFO_DUPLICATE';alias=(a,b)
  if a[4]=='/proc':assert procmount is None,'MEMINFO_DUPLICATE';procmount=(a,b)
 device=str(os.major(dev))+':'+str(os.minor(dev));assert alias and alias[0][2]==device and alias[0][3]=='/meminfo' and alias[1][:2]==['proc','proc'] and 'ro' in alias[0][5].split(',') and 'rw' not in alias[0][5].split(','),'MEMINFO_READONLY_ALIAS'
 assert procmount and procmount[1][:2]==['proc','proc'] and 'subset=pid' in procmount[1][2].split(',') and any(x in procmount[1][2].split(',') for x in ['hidepid=invisible','hidepid=2']),'MEMINFO_PRIVATE_PROC'
 return True
def proc_filesystem(fd):
 # Linux libc fstatfs writes into a conservatively sized buffer; only the first
 # native-long f_type is inspected. Refuse other ABIs; never invent a Python API.
 import ctypes
 assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.uname().machine=='x86_64' and ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_long)==8,'STATFS_ABI_UNVERIFIED'
 library=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True);fn=library.fstatfs;fn.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_void_p];fn.restype=ctypes.c_int;buf=ctypes.create_string_buffer(4096)
 assert fn(fd,ctypes.byref(buf))==0,'STATFS_REFUSED';assert ctypes.c_long.from_buffer(buf).value==0x9fa0,'HOST_PROC_FILESYSTEM'
 return True
def prove_host_meminfo(binding,deadline):
 end=min(deadline,time.monotonic()+0.5);held=[]
 def check():budget(end)
 def op(path,flags):
  check();f=os.open(path,flags);held.append(f);return f
 def rel(fd,name,directory=False):
  assert re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+',name),'MEMINFO_FIXED_LEAF'
  return op('/proc/self/fd/'+str(fd)+'/'+name,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK|(os.O_DIRECTORY if directory else 0))
 def meta(fd):
  x=os.fstat(fd);return (x.st_dev,x.st_ino,x.st_mode,x.st_uid,x.st_gid,x.st_nlink)
 def read(fd,cap):
  check();before=meta(fd);assert stat.S_ISREG(before[2]),'MEMINFO_TYPE';b=bytearray()
  while len(b)<=cap:
   check();x=os.pread(fd,min(8192,cap+1-len(b)),len(b))
   if not x:break
   b.extend(x)
  assert len(b)<=cap and before==meta(fd),'MEMINFO_DRIFT';return bytes(b).decode()
 def live():
  check();p=native_properties(BINDING['nativeUnit'],end);assert native_same(p,binding) and p['MainPID']==str(binding['pid']) and p['ActiveState']=='active','MEMINFO_EPOCH';child_limits(p);return p
 try:
  live();root=op('/',os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW);procfd=rel(root,'proc',True);proc_filesystem(procfd);host=rel(procfd,'meminfo');hostmeta=meta(host);assert stat.S_ISREG(hostmeta[2]) and hostmeta[3]==0 and hostmeta[5]==1,'HOST_MEMINFO_META';proc_filesystem(host)
  pidfd=rel(procfd,str(binding['pid']),True);pidmeta=meta(pidfd);assert stat.S_ISDIR(pidmeta[2]) and pidmeta[3]==1000,'MEMINFO_PID_DIRECTORY'
  def epoch():
   ps=read(rel(pidfd,'stat'),8192);xs=ps[ps.rfind(')')+2:].split();st=read(rel(pidfd,'status'),16384);cg=read(rel(pidfd,'cgroup'),8192)
   assert xs[19]==binding['startTicks'] and re.search(r'^Uid:\s+1000\s+1000\s+1000\s+1000$',st,re.M) and cg.strip()=='0::'+binding['cgroup'],'MEMINFO_KERNEL_EPOCH'
   ns=os.readlink('/proc/self/fd/'+str(pidfd)+'/ns/mnt');assert re.fullmatch(r'mnt:\[[1-9][0-9]*\]',ns),'MEMINFO_NAMESPACE';assert os.readlink('/proc/self/fd/'+str(pidfd)+'/ns/pid')==os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/pid'),'PID_NAMESPACE_CHANGED';return ns
  ns=epoch();assert ns!=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/mnt'),'MEMINFO_NAMESPACE_NOT_ISOLATED'
  rootpath='/proc/self/fd/'+str(pidfd)+'/root';assert stat.S_ISLNK(os.lstat(rootpath).st_mode),'MEMINFO_ROOT_LINK';childroot=op(rootpath,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY);rootmeta=meta(childroot);control=rel(childroot,'control',True);alias=rel(control,'HOST_MEMINFO');assert meta(alias)==hostmeta,'MEMINFO_ALIAS_IDENTITY';proc_filesystem(alias)
  def mounts():validate_meminfo_mounts(read(rel(pidfd,'mountinfo'),131072),hostmeta[0])
  mounts()
  for text in [read(host,65536),read(alias,65536)]:
   m=re.search(r'^MemAvailable:\s+(\d+)\s+kB$',text,re.M);assert m and int(m[1])*1024>=4*1073741824,'MEMINFO_RAM'
  assert epoch()==ns and meta(pidfd)==pidmeta and meta(childroot)==rootmeta and meta(host)==hostmeta and meta(alias)==hostmeta,'MEMINFO_AFTER_EPOCH';live();mounts();freshroot=op(rootpath,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY);assert meta(freshroot)==rootmeta,'MEMINFO_ROOT_DRIFT';freshalias=rel(rel(freshroot,'control',True),'HOST_MEMINFO');assert meta(freshalias)==hostmeta,'MEMINFO_ALIAS_DRIFT';proc_filesystem(freshalias);assert epoch()==ns,'MEMINFO_FINAL_EPOCH';live();check()
 finally:
  failed=False
  for fd in reversed(held):
   try:os.close(fd)
   except OSError:failed=True
  assert not failed,'MEMINFO_CLOSE_UNKNOWN'
 # No failing descriptor cleanup may occur after the release.
 live();check();return {'hostMeminfoReadOnlyBound':True,'namespaceEpochBound':True}

def stop_native(binding,deadline):
 def exact_owned_state(p):
  return native_same(p,binding) and p.get('Id')==BINDING['nativeUnit'] and p.get('InvocationID')==binding['invocation'] and p.get('Description')==binding['description'] and p.get('ControlGroup')==binding['cgroup'] and (p.get('MainPID')==str(binding['pid']) or p.get('MainPID')=='0' and original_epoch_gone(binding))
 p=native_properties(BINDING['nativeUnit'],deadline)
 if native_ceased(p,binding):return False
 assert exact_owned_state(p),'FOREIGN_REPLACEMENT_NO_STOP'
 command=['-n','/usr/bin/systemctl','stop','--no-block',BINDING['nativeUnit']];check_command_authority(command,deadline)
 p=native_properties(BINDING['nativeUnit'],deadline);assert exact_owned_state(p) and not native_ceased(p,binding),'FOREIGN_REPLACEMENT_NO_STOP'
 r=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/sudo',*command],capture_output=True,timeout=budget(deadline,0.5),env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LC_ALL':'C'});assert r.returncode==0 and len(r.stdout)<=32768 and len(r.stderr)<=8192,'NATIVE_STOP_REFUSED';return True

def reconcile_native(transport,binding,expected,deadline,eof):
 # Fresh native cessation, original PID epoch, transport exit AND stream EOF.
 out={'nativeChildClosed':False,'transportExited':False,'stdoutEOF':'stdout' in eof,'stderrEOF':'stderr' in eof,'externalProducerClosureRequired':True,'wholeProcessTreeProven':False,'custodyDisposition':'UNRESOLVED_NATIVE_CUSTODY'}
 try:
  p=native_properties(BINDING['nativeUnit'],deadline);out['transportExited']=transport is not None and transport.poll() is not None
  if binding is not None:out['nativeChildClosed']=native_ceased(p,binding)
  elif native_absent(p,expected):out['nativeChildAbsentNoEpochBound']=True
  out['wholeOwnedChildClosed']=binding is not None and out['nativeChildClosed'] and out['transportExited'] and out['stdoutEOF'] and out['stderrEOF']
  if out['wholeOwnedChildClosed']:out['custodyDisposition']='CHILD_CLOSED_EXTERNAL_PRODUCER_WITNESS_REQUIRED'
 except Exception:out['failedGate']='NATIVE_CLOSURE_UNKNOWN';out['wholeOwnedChildClosed']=False
 return out
